profile_text.body:
Lokalise describes itself as a continuous localization and translation management platform that integrates into a development workflow so teams can ship localized products. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Newark, Delaware, and its site presents localization as a single system that connects workflows, standardizes execution, and uses AI to produce consistent, on-brand experiences across markets.

Its tracked product is Lokalise AI, described as localization AI for continuous translation within developer workflows and hosted in the UK. According to the company, the AI applies approved terminology, tone of voice, and vocabulary to keep translations consistent with a brand across languages, and it uses Custom AI Profiles, surrounding context, and metadata to preserve meaning, with AI Scoring to evaluate translation quality automatically so that only low-confidence results need human review. The site also says Lokalise dynamically selects and routes to the best-fit LLM based on language, content, and context, and that role-based access control applies across the platform and its API, using the same model as the web interface. The company's own material notes that AI translation tools do not fully replace human translators.

The company's legal exposure record lists 27 cases in Delaware.
